nom: Good Molecules Caffeine Energizing Hydrogel Eye Patches

segments.sensitive: Reports are split: several reviewers with sensitive skin describe burning, tingling, redness, or rash within minutes of application (e.g. reviews 4, 5, 16, 36), while others with self-described very sensitive skin or eczema report no irritation and good hydration (52, 53).
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature skin uses the patches nightly after a retinol oil and reports no irritation, hydration, and smoother under-eyes.
segments.dry: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin found the patches insufficiently hydrating and prone to pilling before other products could be applied.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother, tighter, and brighter under-eye skin with regular use, including reduced appearance of fine lines and smile lines; one wished for a full-face version, and one mature-skin user found it fit well into an anti-aging routine with retinol.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe an immediate cooling, hydrating effect and softer, plumper under-eye skin after use; a few say the patches did not fully absorb or hydrate enough for their skin type.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers report the patches themselves caused new redness, chemical-burn-like marks, or bright red swollen patches shaped like the pads, sometimes lasting hours; a smaller number report no redness or irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe burning, tingling, dermatitis, or rash-like reactions they attribute to a compromised or reactive barrier response, including one who developed persistent dermatitis for days; others with normal or resilient skin report no such response.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers note reduction in dark circles or discoloration under the eyes with continued use, though one says the dark-circle issue is still a work in progress.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the product consistently caused milia bumps under the eyes.

aspects.libelle: Serum pills and rolls off skin

extraits.texte: I added these into my skincare routine because they looked great. However, I put them on as directed, they were on for about 4 minutes before I ripped them off. They had burned my face! A horrible angey burn that was broken out into a burning rash all over my face by the next day and lasted several days. I did not have anything else on my skin when I put these on so there was no chemical reaction with another product. I do not have sensitive skin. My skin was clean and dry as directed. After a deep dive into reviews on TikTok, many others have the same issue with this product.

It was cooling in the beginning, but after leaving them on for 10 min, they made my skin have little red dots and feel really tight after removing. I dont have extremely sensitive skin, but these def gave me some problems. Looking for new eyepatches!

extraits.titre: Not for adult skin or before makeup
extraits.texte: I bought this to try to incorporate moisturizing, cooling eye masks into my morning routine. I have genetic dark circles, eye bags, and normal to dry skin. These feel wet on the skin, but not cooling , so didnt help "wake me up". Also, these were not hydrating enough for my skin type. Additionally, these pilled immediately, before I put on other products. I gave these to my teenager daughters and they enjoyed them. I think these are only suitable for youth as an introduction to eye masks.

I've been using these eye patches for a couple years now and I love them! They definitely help make my under eyes look hydrated! I personally keep them in the refrigerator to make the experience more relaxing. Not quite sure if you're supposed to do that, but it feels great! The reasoning for 4/5 stars is because after 5 ish minutes it starts to tingle and become uncomfortable. But I don't ever have a bad reaction! The product is still great imo. I just have sensitive skin!

extraits.titre: Great for Mature Skin — A Nighttime Staple
extraits.texte: I have mature skin, and these Good Molecules caffeine hydrogel patches have become a true staple in my nighttime routine. After applying my Good Molecules 1% retinol oil, I put these on and they add the perfect boost of hydration and depuffing. They never irritate my skin, and the cooling feel is such a relaxing way to end the day. I wake up looking more refreshed, and my under‑eyes feel smoother and well‑hydrated. I keep coming back to them because they truly make a difference.

Ive seen a lot of reviews about skin rashes… as someone with VERY sensitive skin + eczema, I was shocked this product feel as good as it does. Right when I put them on I feel thwm working and they brighten my undereyes and depuff so well. My favprite part is that I can wear them to places and people dont really notice I have them on lol.

I buy these on repeat! They always make me look less tired and they leave the area under the eye looking hydrated and tight. I have very sensitive skin, and they never irritate my skin. I like to put them in the fridge too, the cold always wakes me up :)
